newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,357 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,357 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 1,357 contracts compared with 1,540 overnight Monday.
There were 384 wheat, 537 corn, 342 soybean, 10 soymeal, 73 corn calls, five soybean calls and six soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was steady to one cent higher, corn was one to 1-1/2 cents higher and soybeans were 2-1/4 to 7-1/2 cents higher.
